output.headline: Call Advocate Health, UPMC and Nordic Capital first; price at the top of range
sentences: Call Advocate Health first, then Nordic Capital and UPMC: Advocate pays above the comparable median, UPMC has a perfect close record, and Nordic Capital has the deepest sponsor provider record. [E:tier1]

Upper-quartile pricing of 15.3x EBITDA is defensible given the target's margin, and the strategics can clearly pay it; sponsors reach about $193M to $216M, so strategics are better placed. [E:valuation, E:lbo]
The review removed Steward Health Care (bankrupt), folded Atrium Health into Advocate Health, and set aside Veritas Capital, Vista Equity and Francisco Partners as off-mandate. [E:review, E:tier2]
Geographic expansion is the motive most buyers share in provider deals, so pitch the target's Midwest footprint as their entry point on every call. [E:motives, E:target]
